title: HazardBot: Hazardous Environment Exploration Rover
subtitle: Dual-Controlled (WiFi + Bluetooth) Environmental Sensing Rover
description: A low-cost (~$24) dual-controlled (Bluetooth + WiFi) two-wheel rover designed to enter hazardous environments and stream real-time telemetry (MQ-2 gas, MQ-135 air quality, DHT11 temp/humidity) to a smartphone Progressive Web App and embedded web server running on an ESP32-WROOM-32.
